seo.title: Travizia 2024 Travel Calendar Design | Shubham Pendse
seo.description: A 13-page travel-themed desk calendar designed for Travizia Tours & Travels.

sections.heading: Project overview
sections.body: Travizia's 2024 calendar needed to function as both a useful desk object and a year-long brand touchpoint. Each month pairs a destination image with a compact date grid, contact information and service icons while keeping the overall system consistent enough to feel like one complete publication.

items.title: Destination-led storytelling
items.body: A new place leads each month, allowing the calendar to reinforce Travizia's travel positioning throughout the year.

items.title: Consistent monthly rhythm
items.body: The repeated image, date and service structure creates familiarity while the destination photography keeps every page fresh.

items.title: Useful brand visibility
items.body: Contact information remains easy to find without competing with the date grid or destination imagery.
